'''Hector''' is an NPC in [[Ragunna]], [[Rinascita]].

During the daytime, he can be seen preparing to ship spices to [[Septimont]]. At night, he talks to his aunt, [[Joanne]] about his free time in the Septimont.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Hector:''' Checking the cargo... getting the paperwork ready... and I still need to send off those Acolytes later. Tsk, I should have asked the family for more help.
:{{DIcon}} Are you getting ready to set sail?
:'''Hector:''' Yes, we're shipping a large batch of spices to Septimont. Everyone's been super busy lately.
:{{DIcon}} Septimont?
:'''Hector:''' Haven't been there? The arena events there are amazing with all those Echo gladiators! I'll definitely sneak out to watch a few matches when we arrive.
----
;(At night)
:'''Joanne:''' Hector, I'll grant you two days of free time in the Septimont.
:'''Joanne:''' Return to Ragunna on time in two days and report to me at the bank.
:'''Hector:''' Aunt Joanne... you're drilling this into my ears...
:'''Joanne:''' That's not how you address me! Mr. Hector.
:'''Hector:''' Yes, ma'am... Lady Joanne.
:'''Joanne:''' Before we set sail, you swore to Imperator.
:'''Hector:''' Hail Imperator. I, Hector, swear I'll never again bet on gladiator fights in the Septimont's underground casinos—
:'''Hector:''' Or let me perish at sea, never to return home!
:'''Joanne:''' If you're going to perish, fine. But don't drag down your colleagues or the cargo; they've done nothing wrong.
:'''Joanne:''' You can watch matches, but if I find you at the betting tables again—",
:'''Hector:''' —you'll fire me on the spot, freeze all my accounts, and have me sent to Averardo Vault's underground worksite.
:'''Joanne:''' I promised your mother I'd take care of you. Don't make her shed any more tears.
{{Dialogue End}}
